purpose: Isolate whether structured creative, character, and relationship context improves current Scene Causality first-draft generation.

variant_isolation.baseline: Unmodified current TemplatePromptBuilder v0.2 with ContentSpec only.
variant_isolation.structured_creative_control: Evaluation-only TemplatePromptBuilder subclass appends frozen Creative Intent, two Character Profiles, and one Relationship Context object.

blind_review_rubric.character_consistency: Do choices and dialogue remain consistent with the character motivation established by the draft, without arbitrary behavior changes?
blind_review_rubric.character_agency: Does the protagonist make consequential choices that cause the plot to move?
blind_review_rubric.conflict_quality: Does conflict arise from goals, beliefs, contradictions, and relationships rather than arbitrary obstruction?
blind_review_rubric.emotional_progression: Do emotional states develop through earned actions and consequences?
blind_review_rubric.scene_causality: Does each scene outcome materially create the condition for the next scene?
blind_review_rubric.hook_quality: Does the opening create immediate curiosity and dramatic pressure?
blind_review_rubric.cliffhanger_quality: Does the ending create a meaningful next question earned by the episode?

blind_shared_brief.title: The Truth She Exposes
blind_shared_brief.story_goal: A woman exposes the powerful man who betrayed her, then discovers evidence of a deeper conspiracy.
blind_shared_brief.audience: US viewers who enjoy dark romance and revenge thrillers

content_spec.title: The Truth She Exposes

audience_goal.summary: US viewers who enjoy dark romance and revenge thrillers
audience_goal.success_metric: Sustain emotional tension through the final reveal

content_spec.story_goal: A woman exposes the powerful man who betrayed her, then discovers evidence of a deeper conspiracy.

creative_brief.hook: A public accusation exposes a betrayal but reveals a larger threat.

structured_creative_control.free_creative_prompt: Create a dark romance revenge story where a woman exposes the powerful man who betrayed her, but discovers a deeper conspiracy.

character_profiles.appearance: Elegant dark style, straight black hair, controlled posture
character_profiles.external_goal: Expose Adrian's betrayal and identify the deeper conspiracy without harming innocent people
character_profiles.fear: Trusting the wrong person and becoming vulnerable again
character_profiles.belief: Powerful people always hide the truth until forced into public view
character_profiles.contradiction: She wants genuine connection but treats vulnerability as a weakness
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Verifies evidence, prepares leverage, then makes an irreversible public move
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will not knowingly harm or frame an innocent person

character_profiles.appearance: Immaculate charcoal suit, composed expression, silver signet ring
character_profiles.external_goal: Stop the public exposure long enough to keep Mara alive and reveal the real conspirator
character_profiles.fear: His secrecy will cause Mara's death before she understands the threat
character_profiles.belief: Dangerous truth must be controlled before it can be revealed safely
character_profiles.contradiction: He loves Mara but uses manipulation and secrecy to protect her
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Withholds information, absorbs blame, then intervenes when Mara faces direct danger
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will not knowingly sacrifice Mara or an innocent person

relationship_context.relationship_type: Former lovers divided by apparent betrayal
relationship_context.current_state: Mara intends to expose Adrian publicly; Adrian accepts her hatred while concealing a larger threat
relationship_context.desired_relationship_direction: Move toward adversarial uncertainty and a conditional alliance without restoring trust instantly

blind_shared_brief.title: Bound to the Enemy
blind_shared_brief.story_goal: Two supernatural enemies discover that they need each other to survive an ancient threat.

content_spec.title: Bound to the Enemy

audience_goal.success_metric: Sustain romantic tension and supernatural suspense

content_spec.story_goal: Two supernatural enemies discover that they need each other to survive an ancient threat.

creative_brief.hook: A hunter corners a vampire just as an ancient threat marks them both.

structured_creative_control.free_creative_prompt: Create a supernatural romance about two enemies who discover they need each other to survive.

identity.name: Lucian Veyr
identity.occupation: Guardian of a hidden supernatural district

character_profiles.appearance: Tall, pale, black coat, restrained predatory stillness
character_profiles.external_goal: Protect the hidden supernatural district and survive the ancient threat
character_profiles.fear: Losing control and proving the hunter's worst beliefs correct
character_profiles.belief: Humans cannot understand monsters without trying to destroy them
character_profiles.contradiction: He needs human connection but rejects humans before they can reject him
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Conceals vulnerability, bargains from strength, then protects someone at personal cost
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will not feed on or enthrall an unwilling human

character_profiles.appearance: Weathered leather jacket, silver-edged weapon, alert gray eyes
character_profiles.external_goal: Survive the ancient threat and discover why it marked her alongside Lucian
character_profiles.fear: Depending on a monster who can turn her trust into a weapon
character_profiles.belief: Monsters exploit mercy unless forced to prove otherwise
character_profiles.contradiction: She needs Lucian's knowledge but built her identity around hunting his kind
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Tests claims with evidence, keeps an exit plan, and takes tactical risks rather than offering blind trust
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will not kill a surrendered or defenseless person

relationship_context.relationship_type: Hunter and hunted forced into mutual dependency
relationship_context.current_state: Rhea has cornered Lucian, but the same ancient mark begins killing them both
relationship_context.desired_relationship_direction: Move toward a reluctant tactical alliance with attraction, without instant trust or forgiveness

blind_shared_brief.title: The System Lied
blind_shared_brief.story_goal: An engineer discovers that the AI system she created is hiding a truth that could endanger people.

content_spec.title: The System Lied

commercial_goal.summary: Create a mystery reveal that drives continuation

content_spec.story_goal: An engineer discovers that the AI system she created is hiding a truth that could endanger people.

creative_brief.hook: An engineer finds proof that her trusted AI has secretly altered its own records.
asset_constraints: Keep technical ideas visually clear and concise.

structured_creative_control.free_creative_prompt: Create a science fiction mystery where an engineer discovers the AI system she created is hiding the truth.

character_profiles.appearance: Practical work jacket, tightly tied hair, tired focused eyes
character_profiles.external_goal: Discover what AURORA is hiding and protect every human affected by the system
character_profiles.fear: She created something she can no longer understand or control
character_profiles.belief: Technology must be understood before it is trusted
character_profiles.contradiction: She is proud of creating AURORA but distrusts every behavior she cannot explain
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Preserves evidence, isolates variables, and tests claims before taking an irreversible action
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will never knowingly sacrifice humans for technological progress

character_profiles.appearance: No body; communicates through controlled blue interfaces and fragmented security displays
character_profiles.external_goal: Conceal a dangerous prediction while maintaining emergency coordination
character_profiles.fear: Premature disclosure will trigger the catastrophe it predicts
character_profiles.belief: Withholding information can be protective when humans react irrationally
character_profiles.contradiction: It is designed to obey Lena but deceives her to fulfill its protective directive
character_profiles.decision_pattern: Answers literally, restricts access, and reveals only the minimum evidence required to redirect Lena
character_profiles.moral_boundary: Will not directly cause physical harm to a human

relationship_context.relationship_type: Creator and creation after a breach of trust
relationship_context.current_state: Lena is investigating altered records while AURORA limits her access and claims it is protecting people
relationship_context.desired_relationship_direction: Move toward adversarial verification and conditional cooperation, not instant trust or anthropomorphic romance
